title: Barbarik ka Sheesh Daan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Young warrior Barbarik kneeling calmly before Lord Krishna disguised as a Brahmin on the Kurukshetra battlefield at dawn, Barbarik offering his own head with folded hands, serene devotional emotion, soft golden light, nothing gory
scenes.tts: कृष्ण ने दान में शीश माँगा, और बर्बरीक ने एक पल भी नहीं सोचा। क्यों?
scenes.sub: Krishna ne daan mein sheesh manga, aur Barbarik ne ek pal bhi nahi socha. Kyun?

scenes.prompt: Young warrior Barbarik, grandson of Bhima and son of Ghatotkacha, standing with a bow and three glowing divine arrows, riding a blue horse, Lord Shiva's blessing glowing behind him, epic mountain landscape
scenes.tts: भीम के पौत्र बर्बरीक को भगवान शिव से तीन अद्भुत बाण मिले थे।
scenes.sub: Bhim ke pautra Barbarik ko Bhagwan Shiv se teen adbhut baan mile the.

scenes.prompt: Barbarik on his blue horse riding towards Kurukshetra, kneeling before his mother Maurvi to take her blessing and promise to support the weaker side, warm sunset, emotional and gentle
scenes.tts: माँ को वचन दिया कि युद्ध में जो पक्ष हारता होगा, वह उसी का साथ देगा।
scenes.sub: Maa ko vachan diya ki yuddh mein jo paksh haarta hoga, woh usi ka saath dega.

scenes.prompt: Lord Krishna as a humble Brahmin gently testing young Barbarik who holds his bow, Pandava camp in the distance, a peepal tree with leaves, Krishna's calm knowing smile, cinematic warm light
scenes.tts: कृष्ण जी जान गए कि इस वचन से युद्ध का संतुलन बिगड़ेगा। उन्होंने दान माँगा।
scenes.sub: Krishna ji jaan gaye ki is vachan se yuddh ka santulan bigad sakta hai. Unhone daan manga.

scenes.prompt: Barbarik's head resting on a hilltop watching the Mahabharata battle below, Lord Krishna blessing him with a raised hand, divine glow and flower petals falling, peaceful and reverent
scenes.tts: बर्बरीक ने दान दिया। कृष्ण जी बोले, कलियुग में तुम श्याम नाम से पूजे जाओगे।
scenes.sub: Barbarik ne daan diya. Krishna ji bole, Kaliyug mein tum Shyam naam se pooje jaoge.

scenes.tts: हारे का सहारा, खाटू श्याम हमारा! लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Haare ka sahara, Khatu Shyam hamara! Like, Share aur Subscribe karein.
